text:
henri: quick follow-up from the postmortem: we observed a repeated pattern where registrar throttling + LB sticky fallback caused a flurry of retries and 504s for cross-region eu -> na traffic during the 2026-03-20 maintenance window. postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2198000000. opening thread to track owners/timelines.

lia: i looked at the traces— most spikes line up with bursts of registrar updates. LB's fallback logic then reassigned cookies to older pools before route tables converged.

omar: agree. this is mostly a propagation/timing issue, but TLS handshakes timed out when proxies dropped mid-handshake which amplified retries.

infra-bot: Incident 2198000000 created: dns-throttle-lb-fallback. Severity P2. Linked: INC-9601, TKT-2401.

rachel: proposed remediation items (draft):
- smooth registrar update bursts (owner: omar)
- add deploy pre-check for route propagation (owner: lia)
- LB sticky-fallback guard that respects route-version label (owner: henri)
- add a cross-region synthetic and alert (owner: cs-team)
- update runbook + customer message template (owner: rachel)

omar: vendor ticket created VND-4602. timeline: vendor reply ETA 2026-03-27. i'll prototype rate-smoothing in sandbox and post results. target PR: 2026-04-04.

lia: pre-check plan: gating webhook queries edge/route-status for expected route-version during canary. PR by 2026-04-01, canary gating 2026-04-02. gate fails if >1% of edges disagree.

henri: LB guard: prototype by 2026-04-06; canary 10% traffic for 2h. acceptance: no sticky-fallback events and no uptick in 5xx. rollback automatic on failure.

cs-team: we'll add a synthetic probe from eu-west, eu-central, and us-east every 5m validating X-RW-Route-Version header. alert: route_mismatch_ratio > 0.25% for 10m -> P3; escalate to P2 if >1% for 15m. target: 2026-03-31.

rachel: runbook acceptance criteria please so CS knows when to close. add exact customer blurb too.

omar: sample PromQL for registrar errors:
```
sum(rate(registrar_update_errors_total[5m])) by (region)
```

lia: sample deploy gate pseudo:
```
# deploy webhook
mismatch=$(curl -s https://edge-api/route-status?expected=v63 | jq '.mismatch_count')
if [ $(echo "$mismatch / $TOTAL_EDGES > 0.01" | bc) -eq 1 ]; then exit 1; fi
```

henri: LB guard detail: only reassign sticky cookies if backend has `route-version==expected`. otherwise keep session pinned and drain later. document rollback: revert lb-configmap, restore sticky cookie TTL, drain canary nodes. i'll post k8s commands in PR.

rachel: smoke test checklist to add in PRs:
- run synthetic route-version check 20x from eu-west -> expect v63 in X-RW-Route-Version
- verify `sum(rate(edge_route_mismatch_total[5m]))` < 10 over 30m
- sandbox registrar burst test: registrar_update_errors_total < 0.01%
- openssl resume smoke: `openssl s_client -connect edge-proxy:443 -servername api.redwood.example -sess_out s.bin` then reconnect with `-sess_in s.bin` to confirm resume

cs-team: customer comms: CS notified top 6 accounts already. we'll prepare a post-canary update template.

omar: vendor sandbox tests starting tomorrow. i'll attach results and ticket links to INC-9601.

lia: i'll open the deploy-gate PR today and add the webhook test harness.

henri: ack, opening LB guard PR early next week.

rachel: ack, drafting runbook now and will link here.

infra-bot: Calendar invite: follow-up sync 2026-04-03 15:00 UTC to review PR status and canary readiness.

henri: final owners + dates: omar (rate-smoothing & vendor test) PR by 2026-04-04; lia (pre-deploy gate) PR 2026-04-01; henri (LB guard) PR 2026-04-06; cs-team (synthetic + alert) 2026-03-31; rachel (runbook + CS msg) 2026-03-30.

omar: ack. starting sandbox work.

lia: ack, will post PR link when ready.

rachel: thanks all. i'll close this thread once PRs + runbook links are attached. reopen if blockers. :white_check_mark:
